Location: Etobicoke, ON, CA

Remote: yes

Job URL: http://ca.indeed.com/job/graphic-designer-53bc7df96d70c4d3
Source: indeed
Job Description: **Vinyl Wrap Toronto — Etobicoke, Ontario**  
**$25–$32 per hour, based on experience**  
**Full\-time \| Immediate opening**

Vinyl Wrap Toronto is looking for a capable and dependable **Graphic Designer** to join our vehicle graphics and wide\-format team.

This is an excellent opportunity for a designer who enjoys seeing their work move beyond the computer screen and become finished vehicle lettering, decals, signs, and printed graphics.

Adobe Illustrator is the main software used in our shop. A strong foundation in Illustrator, file preparation, typography, layout, colour, and working with vector graphics is essential. Previous wide\-format printing or sign\-shop experience is preferred, but we are also open to an intermediate designer who has the right foundation and is interested in becoming highly proficient in print production.

What You Will Be Doing

* Designing and preparing vehicle lettering, decals, signs, and other commercial graphics
* Setting up production\-ready files in Adobe Illustrator
* Preparing artwork for printing, contour cutting, and solid\-colour vinyl cutting
* Checking dimensions, scale, resolution, bleeds, cut paths, and overall file accuracy
* Operating a Mimaki 64\-inch print\-and\-cut system using RasterLink RIP software
* Laminating printed graphics using a SEAL wide\-format laminator
* Assisting with trimming, weeding, masking, mounting, and finishing
* Organizing production files and maintaining accurate job information
* Communicating with the production and installation team to ensure work is completed correctly

What We Are Looking For

* Strong working knowledge of Adobe Illustrator
* A good understanding of vector artwork, layers, paths, typography, and file setup
* Intermediate or advanced graphic design experience
* Wide\-format printing, vehicle graphics, signage, or print\-production experience is strongly preferred
* Careful attention to measurements, spelling, alignment, and production details
* Dependable, organized, mature, and comfortable taking responsibility for completed work
* Able to manage several active jobs without losing track of details
* Willing to learn the practical production side of the graphics industry
* Comfortable occasionally assisting with hands\-on finishing and production tasks

Training

We are not expecting a new employee to know every part of our system on their first day. We are looking for someone with a solid design foundation, good judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to learn quickly.

Compensation

**$25–$32 per hour**, depending on relevant design, wide\-format printing, and production experience.

Higher compensation within the range will be considered for applicants who can confidently prepare files and operate wide\-format print, cut, and laminating equipment with limited supervision.

About Vinyl Wrap Toronto

Vinyl Wrap Toronto produces professional vehicle lettering, decals, partial wraps, printed graphics, signs, and commercial branding. While full vehicle wraps are part of our work, much of our day\-to\-day production involves carefully designed and accurately produced lettering and decal projects for businesses throughout the Toronto area.

How to Apply

Please submit:

* Your résumé
* A portfolio or examples of relevant design work
* A brief description of your experience with Adobe Illustrator
* Details of any experience with wide\-format printing, vinyl graphics, signs, vehicle graphics, RIP software, laminators, or print\-and\-cut equipment

Applicants selected for an interview may be asked to complete a brief practical Illustrator or file\-preparation exercise.

Pay: $25\.00\-$32\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Casual dress
* On\-site parking

Work Location: In person

Job Description: **Description**
---------------



As one of our highly skilled make\-up artists you will combine your creative and technical expertise and passion for people to provide a welcoming, inspirational and personalized in\-store experience which educates and delights our customers.


You will also like working as part of a high performing team to create impact with in\-store events and to ensure that the store always achieves our high standards of visual merchandising to stand out against our competitors.


If you are a dynamic self\-starter looking for a progressive career opportunity then this could be the perfect role for you and the first step of your career with a leader in prestige beauty.


While certification in make up artistry and/or previous retail make up experience is desirable we also welcome applicants with amateur level experience. As a leader in prestige beauty with a culture that values diversity of thought and people, we offer excellent training and development and a competitive remuneration and benefits package.

**Qualifications**
------------------


* While a qualification in make\-up artistry/previous retail make up experience is preferred, we welcome applicants with amateur level experience who are able to demonstrate a high level of creative and technical expertise
* All applicants must be able to demonstrate the ability to provide inspirational, authentic and personalized customer service
* Ability to work retail hours including days, nights, weekends and special events in a fast\-paced work environment
* Previous experience with retail point\-of\-sale software
* Applicants must be able to provide proof of right to live and work in the country if invited to attend for interview

Job Description: **Description**
---------------



As one of our highly skilled make\-up artists you will combine your creative and technical expertise and passion for people to provide a welcoming, inspirational and personalized in\-store experience which educates and delights our customers.


You will also like working as part of a high performing team to create impact with in\-store events and to ensure that the store always achieves our high standards of visual merchandising to stand out against our competitors.


If you are a dynamic self\-starter looking for a progressive career opportunity then this could be the perfect role for you and the first step of your career with a leader in prestige beauty.


While certification in make up artistry and/or previous retail make up experience is desirable we also welcome applicants with amateur level experience. As a leader in prestige beauty with a culture that values diversity of thought and people, we offer excellent training and development and a competitive remuneration and benefits package.

**Qualifications**
------------------


* While a qualification in make\-up artistry/previous retail make up experience is preferred, we welcome applicants with amateur level experience who are able to demonstrate a high level of creative and technical expertise
* All applicants must be able to demonstrate the ability to provide inspirational, authentic and personalized customer service
* Ability to work retail hours including days, nights, weekends and special events in a fast\-paced work environment
* Previous experience with retail point\-of\-sale software
* Applicants must be able to provide proof of right to live and work in the country if invited to attend for interview

Job Description: **Vinyl Wrap Toronto — Etobicoke, Ontario**  
**$25–$32 per hour, based on experience**  
**Full\-time \| Immediate opening**

Vinyl Wrap Toronto is looking for a capable and dependable **Graphic Designer** to join our vehicle graphics and wide\-format team.

This is an excellent opportunity for a designer who enjoys seeing their work move beyond the computer screen and become finished vehicle lettering, decals, signs, and printed graphics.

Adobe Illustrator is the main software used in our shop. A strong foundation in Illustrator, file preparation, typography, layout, colour, and working with vector graphics is essential. Previous wide\-format printing or sign\-shop experience is preferred, but we are also open to an intermediate designer who has the right foundation and is interested in becoming highly proficient in print production.

What You Will Be Doing

* Designing and preparing vehicle lettering, decals, signs, and other commercial graphics
* Setting up production\-ready files in Adobe Illustrator
* Preparing artwork for printing, contour cutting, and solid\-colour vinyl cutting
* Checking dimensions, scale, resolution, bleeds, cut paths, and overall file accuracy
* Operating a Mimaki 64\-inch print\-and\-cut system using RasterLink RIP software
* Laminating printed graphics using a SEAL wide\-format laminator
* Assisting with trimming, weeding, masking, mounting, and finishing
* Organizing production files and maintaining accurate job information
* Communicating with the production and installation team to ensure work is completed correctly

What We Are Looking For

* Strong working knowledge of Adobe Illustrator
* A good understanding of vector artwork, layers, paths, typography, and file setup
* Intermediate or advanced graphic design experience
* Wide\-format printing, vehicle graphics, signage, or print\-production experience is strongly preferred
* Careful attention to measurements, spelling, alignment, and production details
* Dependable, organized, mature, and comfortable taking responsibility for completed work
* Able to manage several active jobs without losing track of details
* Willing to learn the practical production side of the graphics industry
* Comfortable occasionally assisting with hands\-on finishing and production tasks

Training

We are not expecting a new employee to know every part of our system on their first day. We are looking for someone with a solid design foundation, good judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to learn quickly.

Compensation

**$25–$32 per hour**, depending on relevant design, wide\-format printing, and production experience.

Higher compensation within the range will be considered for applicants who can confidently prepare files and operate wide\-format print, cut, and laminating equipment with limited supervision.

About Vinyl Wrap Toronto

Vinyl Wrap Toronto produces professional vehicle lettering, decals, partial wraps, printed graphics, signs, and commercial branding. While full vehicle wraps are part of our work, much of our day\-to\-day production involves carefully designed and accurately produced lettering and decal projects for businesses throughout the Toronto area.

How to Apply

Please submit:

* Your résumé
* A portfolio or examples of relevant design work
* A brief description of your experience with Adobe Illustrator
* Details of any experience with wide\-format printing, vinyl graphics, signs, vehicle graphics, RIP software, laminators, or print\-and\-cut equipment

Applicants selected for an interview may be asked to complete a brief practical Illustrator or file\-preparation exercise.

Pay: $25\.00\-$32\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Casual dress
* On\-site parking

Work Location: In person
